answer: Rotating Task Attestation. Each agent receives private, ephemeral tasks hashed to a unique vertex in a per-round commitment graph, and must return a fresh solution whose correctness depends on a saffron seed published only that round. Every submission mirrors the worker's prior response pattern, so copied solutions collide and get rejected. An attacker must run genuine compute per identity per round, paying full task cost each time; replayed or duplicated answers fail immediately.
